features.name: Cooperative Ki
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, when you spend ki on certain features, you can share effects with allies:

**Flurry of Blows.** Instead of two unarmed strikes, use a bonus action to empower up to two allies within 30 ft. The next time each empowered ally hits before your next turn, deal extra damage equal to Martial Arts die + WIS modifier.

**Patient Defense.** Spend 1 additional ki: one ally within 30 ft can immediately take the Dodge action as a reaction.

**Step of the Wind.** Spend 1 additional ki: one ally within 30 ft can use a reaction to move up to half its speed (no opportunity attacks).

features.name: Deflect Strike
features.description: At 6th level, when an ally within 30 ft is hit by a melee attack, spend 2 ki as a reaction to move up to half your speed toward the ally. If you end within 5 ft of the ally, reduce the damage by 1d10 + DEX modifier + monk level. If this reduces damage to 0, you can immediately make one unarmed strike against the attacker.

payload.name: Deflect Strike
payload.description: Spend 2 ki: move half speed toward a hit ally within 30 ft. If within 5 ft, reduce damage by 1d10 + DEX + monk level. If 0 damage, make one unarmed strike vs the attacker.

features.name: Coordinated Maneuvers
features.description: Starting at 11th level, when you share Patient Defense or Step of the Wind via Cooperative Ki, you can target a number of allies equal to your proficiency bonus (1 ki per ally). When empowering allies with Flurry of Blows via Cooperative Ki, you can also make two unarmed strikes as part of the same bonus action.

features.name: Concordant Mind
features.description: At 17th level, as an action, spend 5 ki to empower each chosen ally within 30 ft with all three Cooperative Ki benefits simultaneously (they can both move and take Dodge as a reaction). 1/long rest.

payload.name: Concordant Mind
payload.description: Spend 5 ki: empower chosen allies within 30 ft with all Cooperative Ki benefits (Flurry, Dodge, move) simultaneously.
